cmd.start:
👋 Welcome to Qayta!

I can help you figure out what to do with your waste before throwing it away.

Send me a photo of an item and I'll tell you:
• What material it is
• Whether it can be recycled in Uzbekistan
• How to prepare it for recycling

Just send a photo to get started!
cmd.help:
ℹ️ How to use Qayta:

📸 Send a photo — I'll identify the material and give recycling tips.

Commands:
/start — Welcome message
/help — This guide
/lang — Change language

What I can do:
✅ Identify recyclable materials from photos
✅ Give preparation tips

What I can't do yet:
❌ Show nearby collection points (coming soon)
❌ Display the map
photo.unclear: 🤔 I couldn't clearly identify the material from this photo. Please try again with a clearer, well-lit photo of a single item.
photo.busy: ⏳ The recognition service is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
photo.bad_file: 📎 I can only process image files (JPEG, PNG, or WebP). Please send a photo or an image file.
tip.discharge: Tape over the terminals and do not take it apart
tip.handle_safely: Handle with care, do not break
cmd.report: 📝 Tap the button below to report a collection point or a price.
map.title: Recycling map
map.no_points: No collection points found nearby. You can add one to OpenStreetMap.
map.no_location: Location is unavailable. Showing known points without distances.
report.received: ✅ Thank you! Your report was received and will be reviewed.
report.invalid: ⚠️ The report is incomplete. Please fill in all required fields and try again.
review.none_pending: No reports are waiting for review.
